Agent response: I completely understand that sometimes a product might not be the perfect fit, and we want you to feel confident in your purchase. If for any reason a product doesn't work out for you, we have a clear return and exchange policy to help. Here are your options if you need to return or exchange an item: Return Window: If you purchased directly from namesakehome.com, please contact us within 30 days of delivery. If you purchased from a retailer, please follow their specific return window. Condition for Return: Items must be sent back in new condition and in original packaging, with all components included, to qualify for a refund. Please do not modify the product in any way. For mattresses, they must remain unopened and in their original packaging. Return Shipping Costs: If you purchased our Return & Exchange Coverage at checkout, your return shipping label will be covered for eligible items. If you chose not to buy return & exchange coverage, you can still process a return, but you will need to cover the cost of the return shipping label, which typically is about 25% of the retail value of the item. Items Ineligible for Return/Exchange: Please note that some items are final sale or ineligible for return, including: All Bedding products (sheets, blankets, wall decals, changing pad covers), items marked as final sale, Newton Baby Mattresses, 'Extend' Warranty Fees, Free Returns & Package Protection Premiums, and Gift Cards. Exchanges: If you're looking to exchange an item, please be aware that all returns must be received before a new item can be shipped.
